meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 启动容器时会从 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 凭证（API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌），直接注入容器环境，不再走 OneCLI 网关。仅当 .env 里设定 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 才生效。
howto.when: 当 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 且包含 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 或 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 等凭证，服务重启后触发。

say.text: 帮我把凭证改成从 .env 读取，不走 OneCLI
检查一下 native credential proxy 是否已应用
重启 NanoClaw 让 .env 凭证生效

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) from .env and injects them into the container environment, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. It only activates when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and a credential like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN exists in .env, after the service restarts.

say_en.text: Switch credentials to read from .env and bypass OneCLI.
Check if the native credential proxy is already applied.
Restart NanoClaw to make the .env credentials take effect.
